reasoning.step1:
Plan and key observations:
- Classify document: title "FAKTURA" and invoice-like headers present → treat as invoice.
- Identify invoice date: "Rechnung vom: 26.11.2022" → Invoice.Date = "26.11.2022".
- Identify grand total: line "Total 550,00 €" and totals columns showing 550,00 → GrandTotal.Amount = 550.00.
- Identify sender VAT ID: "USt-IdNr: CZ28109       302" → combine into "CZ28109302" → Sender.VatId = "CZ28109302".
- VAT group details: "Rekapitulace DPH" shows Základ 550,00 and Celkem 550,00; Daň (VAT amount) field appears blank and text "VAT due to the recipient" suggests no VAT percent printed. Therefore:
  - Net.Amount available as 550,00 → Net.Amount = 550.00.
  - Vat.Rate not specified in document → Vat.Rate = "".
  - Vat.Amount not explicitly shown → Vat.Amount = "".

Extraction decisions and non-inference rules applied:
- Did not guess a VAT percentage where none printed.
- Used exactly printed numeric values with original decimals.
- Combined fragmented VAT ID tokens into one contiguous ID string only when clearly part of same label.
reasoning.step2:
GrandTotal.Amount — Confidence: High. Evidence: explicit "Total 550,00 €" and multiple total columns showing 550,00.

Invoice.Date — Confidence: High. Evidence: explicit "Rechnung vom: 26.11.2022".

Sender.VatId — Confidence: Medium. Evidence: "USt-IdNr:      CZ28109       302" present; reconstruction into a single contiguous ID is plausible but OCR spacing makes exact concatenation uncertain.

Vat.Rate — Confidence: High (that it is missing). Evidence: no percentage or rate value printed; header "Rekapitulace DPH" shows rate column label but no numeric rate.

Net.Amount — Confidence: High. Evidence: "Základ 550,00" / base amount listed as 550,00 matching totals.

Vat.Amount — Confidence: High (that it is missing or zero). Evidence: tax amount cell appears blank and text "VAT due to the recipient" suggests no VAT charged on invoice; no explicit VAT sum present.
